company: Google LLC (Alphabet Inc.) — Google Compute Engine

ownership.quote: Alphabet Inc. is the parent holding company of Google LLC; Compute Engine is a Google Cloud product line reported within Alphabet's Google Cloud segment.

stage.quote: Alphabet Inc. files annual reports on Form 10-K with the SEC (CIK 0001652044) as a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: GOOGL/GOOG).
stage.note: Compute Engine GPU VMs are a product line of Google Cloud, itself a segment of publicly traded Alphabet Inc.; not independently funded.

revenue.basis: SEC EDGAR XBRL company facts for Alphabet Inc. (CIK 0001652044), us-gaap:Revenues, FY2025 (period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31), as reported in Alphabet's 10-K filing.

note: Google Compute Engine GPU VMs (A2/A3/A4/G2 accelerator-optimized machine families) are a product line of Google Cloud, a segment of publicly traded Alphabet Inc. There is no separate funding history, accelerator participation, or standalone revenue figure for this product; the revenue figure given is Alphabet's whole-company annual revenue (FY2025, per SEC 10-K/XBRL), not Compute Engine's or even Google Cloud segment's revenue specifically.
